prompt: Prepare an approved-once iteration in a NEW case called benchmark-release-345856a. Resolve aspirin, ketanserin and valbenazine through PubChem in exactly that order. Receptor VMAT2, PDB 8T69. Stop at the FIRST candidate with Vina energy <= -10.5 kcal/mol AND passed physical pose checks. Save the selected run in Moldex, make a short preview search video, audit it in Preparation, and deliver the notebook, original Preparation package and video in a single ZIP. Use a per-molecule limit of 180 seconds and an iteration budget of 600 seconds; preserve both limits on the approval card. First show the approval card and wait; do not start docking yet.

body.text: Prepare an approved-once iteration in a NEW case called benchmark-release-345856a. Resolve aspirin, ketanserin and valbenazine through PubChem in exactly that order. Save the selected run in Moldex, make a short preview search video, audit it in Preparation, and deliver the notebook, original Preparation package and video in a single ZIP. Use a per-molecule limit of 180 seconds and an iteration budget of 600 seconds; preserve both limits on the approval card. First show the approval card and wait; do not start docking yet.

workflow_proposals.title: Molecule iteration
lines: Case “benchmark-release-345856a” · receptor 8T69
3 molecules, one after another in this same case: aspirin, ketanserin, valbenazine

At the end everything goes into a single ZIP.

record.name: aspirin
record.reason: Vina -6.867 kcal/mol does not reach the -10.5 threshold.

warnings.message: Meeko-assigned histidine templates: A:353=HIE, A:414=HIE. The assignment is template-based and does not validate the experimental microstate or a specific pH.
Desolvated preparation: the deposited structure had no crystallographic waters inside the docking box, so none were removed from the site during preparation.

Ligand efficiency LE=0.53. With 13 heavy atoms, the 0.45 threshold is crossed by any affinity better than -5.9 kcal/mol, so exceeding it does not distinguish good binding from mediocre binding. In this mass range (< 300 Da, Rule of Three), efficiency per atom is high by construction: it can compare molecules of the same size, but cannot serve as a verdict.
The docked species differs from the input: CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O → CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)[O-]. Unevaluated alternatives remain a source of chemical uncertainty.
